name: elcreator/amount
description: aMount — mount cloud and remote storage (S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SFTP, WebDAV and more, via Flysystem) into the Evolution CMS manager: pick folders, and big files such as backups are uploaded in the background, per manager, within what that manager may see.

suggest.league/flysystem-ftp: FTP/FTPS driver (needs ext-ftp, which many PHP builds omit, so it is not a hard requirement)
suggest.league/flysystem-async-aws-s3: AsyncAws S3 driver (lighter alternative to the AWS SDK)
suggest.azure-oss/storage-blob-flysystem: Azure Blob Storage driver (the successor of the abandoned league/flysystem-azure-blob-storage)
suggest.masbug/flysystem-google-drive-ext: Google Drive driver (personal accounts, shared drives)
suggest.seiger/stask: Alternative queue manager: aMount runs its uploads as an sTask worker when it is installed
